sequence.result: The competing-process fact was dismissed. After the fix, the action exposes no approval control and states that a dismissed required fact blocks authority.
A revised exact preview invalidated version 1 approval and required approval of version 2, then version 3 for the recovery drill.
The UI made no success claim and disabled repeat execution, offering only reconciliation before retry.
Verified appeared only after destination readback matched the approved version.

sequence.harness: The localhost workspace response was delayed for 1.8 seconds so the production Cancel refresh control could be exercised.
sequence.result: The cancellation claimed no newer state and kept the last verified readback visible.
Two retries while the isolated API was stopped preserved the verified prior state and kept Retry readback available.
After the same API restarted, Retry readback restored canonical state; no second effect attempt was created.

truth_boundaries: Fact confirmation grants zero effect authority.
A dismissed action-bound fact cannot be silently treated as confirmed.
Approval is version- and digest-bound and does not claim a result.
Unknown blocks execution retry until destination reconciliation.
Offline and cancelled reads preserve prior readable state without claiming freshness.
